metadata.description: Standardized benchmark template containing 15 diverse student/fresher archetypes spanning Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, AI/NLP, DevOps, QA, Design, Product, and Embedded Systems, alongside 50 realistic entry-level and internship opportunity specifications. Relevance judgments are documented draft annotations prepared according to the CareerPilot annotation protocol, pending multi-annotator human adjudication.
metadata.provenance: Candidate archetypes constructed from realistic college graduate skill profiles and curricula. Opportunities formatted after typical verified entries in the CareerPilot ingestion pipeline.

relevance_scale.0: Not relevant — critical role discipline mismatch, disjoint skills, incompatible work model or experience requirements
relevance_scale.1: Partially relevant — adjacent role title, partial skill match (or transferable foundations), minor negotiable preference gap
relevance_scale.2: Highly relevant — target role alignment, strong core skill overlap, compatible location/work model, meets experience targets

metadata.adjudication_protocol: Requires 2 independent human annotators. Any disagreement (|a1 - a2| > 0) requires panel adjudication with documented evidence.
